messages:
elena: quick sync — target rollout for API 3.2.1 is tomorrow 06:00 UTC. this will be a staggered cutover: us-west canary -> us-east -> eu -> apac. PR is merged, feature-flag gated. need canary owners + rollback contact.

sam: I can own us-west canary. I’ll be oncall 05:30–08:00 UTC. checklist: prewarm pool, run smoke script, monitor latency/5xx for 15m. :thumbsup:

owen: I’ll take eu-west. will run prewarm and run the sample-gen smoke that hits v3/generate + embeddings sample. tagging @priya for client compatibility checks.

priya: client-side note — node & python libs have minor bumps that are backwards compatible, but we removed the legacy `response_format` enum in SDKs; clients using that need a quick patch. I’ll push patch releases tonight and add a short note to changelog. will announce on #general once published.

mira: QA will run the full smoke checklist once owners confirm canary start. I’ll validate: 1) auth header passthrough 2) kv-cache warm hits 3) streaming responses stable 4) latency P95 not regressed.

deploy-bot: automated: scheduled deploy created for 2026-03-18T06:00:00Z, pipeline #build-4123 -> canary. notif on success/failure to this thread.

elena: good. quick ops/rollback plan in case of regressions: revert feature-flag (fast) + rollback gateway to tag v3.2.0. if persistent, rollback whole cutover to v3.2.0 image. rollback command: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api-gateway --to-revision=$(git rev-list -n 1 v3.2.0)` (run from infra-admin).

sam: smoke commands I’ll use:
```
# health check
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/health | jq .
# quick generate smoke
python infra/tools/smoke_test.py --endpoint https://api.redwood.ai/v3/generate --prompt "smoke check" --max-tokens 24
```

owen: for eu I’ll also run an embeddings sanity:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v3/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"test"}' | jq .
```

priya: client comms plan: 1) publish SDK patch 2) short note in developer changelog + breaking-changes section 3) email to top 30 integrators (we have list in shared drive) if they used `response_format`. I’ll draft copy and drop in this thread when ready.

mira: tl;dr preflight checklist for canary owners (to confirm before flip):
- confirm pipeline green + smoke scripts uploaded
- prewarm kv cache (run `python infra/scripts/prewarm.py --pool=api-gateway`)
- validate telemetry: trace ids flowing to console
- <15m steady state with <2% 5xx and latency diff <10% P95

elena: timing note — we’ll start rolling the canary at 06:00 UTC; wait 20m after steady state then promote to next region. owners, please post a thumbs up + timestamp when you start and when you hit steady-state.

sam: starting canary at 06:00 UTC. will post status updates.

owen: will prep eu-warm at 06:20 UTC and start canary at ~06:40 UTC depending on us-west result.

priya: SDK patches ready, pushing within the hour. will paste changelog here when done.

mira: QA will be standing by 05:45–07:30 UTC. I’ll attach a quick results snippet when checks pass.

elena: final ask — please add your pager/contact in this thread: owner + rollback contact. I’ll compile and pin in the ticket.

sam: pager: pagerduty #team-platform, fallback: @sam on slack.

owen: pager: #team-api, fallback: @owen.

priya: contact: @priya (client eng) + email priya@redwood.ai.

mira: contact: @mira (QA).

elena: thanks all. I’ll kick the deploy and update the ticket with timestamps. ping here if anything changes. :rocket:
